description: This file contains implementation of chunk management functions for jemalloc, including chunk allocation, recycling, recording, and deallocation, with thread safety and integration with various memory management strategies.

methods.name: chunk_recycle
methods.description: Recycles or allocates a chunk of memory with specified size and alignment, possibly splitting existing chunks, thread-safe.

methods.name: chunk_record
methods.description: Records a chunk in internal data structures, coalescing with adjacent free chunks, thread-safe.

methods.name: chunk_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a chunk of memory with specified size and alignment, tries multiple strategies, thread-safe.

methods.name: chunk_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a chunk of memory, recording it if necessary.

methods.name: chunk_dealloc
methods.description: Deallocates a chunk of memory, optionally unmapping it.

methods.name: chunk_boot
methods.description: Initializes chunk management system, setting sizes and creating data structures.

methods.name: chunk_prefork
methods.description: Prepares chunk system for a process fork, locking mutexes.

methods.name: chunk_postfork_parent
methods.description: Reinitializes chunk system after fork in parent process.

methods.name: chunk_postfork_child
methods.description: Reinitializes chunk system after fork in child process.
